mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that boosts equity markets, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during easing periods (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the unemployment rate above 10% triggers a negative signal for S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days, as high unemployment indicates a weakening economy.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 50% of triggered instances despite negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) and GDP (GDPC1) both increase, it signals a strong demand environment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window for this interaction-driven signal.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below its 6-month moving average triggers a negative signal for S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, indicating supply chain disruptions.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: The federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and CPI (CPIAUCSL) interact to predict S&P 500 forward returns: when FEDFUNDS is low and CPIAUCSL is high, it signals an inflationary environment with positive returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window for this interaction-driven signal.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in payroll employment (PAYEMS) above its 3-month moving average triggers a positive signal for S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, indicating a strong labor market.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during strong labor market periods (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: The interaction between housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) predicts S&P 500 forward returns: when both are increasing, it signals a strong demand environment with positive returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window for this interaction-driven signal.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 1% triggers a positive signal for S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days, as it indicates an accommodative monetary policy.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in > 50% of triggered instances despite positive signal.
